archetypes.name: Assistive Q&A Agent
archetypes.fv: activity retrieve · effect none · authorisation autonomous · audience internal individual
archetypes.def: Grounded question answering over a defined knowledge corpus, no side effects.
archetypes.ms: M365 Copilot declarative agent + Work IQ + SharePoint/Graph

archetypes.name: Task Execution Agent
archetypes.fv: activity commit · effect record write · reversibility reversible · authorisation policy-bounded
archetypes.def: Performs a bounded transaction in a system of record via tools/skills.
archetypes.ms: Copilot Studio custom engine OR Foundry prompt agent + Dataverse business skills

archetypes.name: Workflow Orchestration Agent
archetypes.fv: activity orchestrate · effect record write · blast radius cohort · authorisation policy-bounded
archetypes.def: Executes a declarative graph of steps with branching and human-in-the-loop.
archetypes.ms: Foundry workflow agent OR Power Automate flow invoked by agent

archetypes.name: Multi-Agent Coordinator
archetypes.fv: activity orchestrate · effect none · blast radius cohort · authorisation policy-bounded
archetypes.def: Dispatches to specialised agents using sequential / concurrent / handoff / group-chat patterns.

archetypes.name: Research / Analytic Agent
archetypes.fv: activity interpret · effect none · input trust corroborated · authorisation autonomous
archetypes.def: Multi-hop retrieval and synthesis across federated sources with citations.
archetypes.ms: Foundry IQ agentic retrieval + Fabric IQ semantic layer

archetypes.name: Autonomous Operations Agent
archetypes.fv: activity orchestrate · effect record write · authorisation autonomous · blast radius cohort
archetypes.def: Event/signal-triggered, runs without per-turn user prompts, own identity.
archetypes.ms: Foundry hosted agent + Entra Agent ID + Managed Identity

archetypes.name: Embedded Copilot Extension
archetypes.fv: activity transform · effect advisory · audience internal individual · authorisation per-action human
archetypes.def: Adds skills/knowledge to the host Copilot inside an M365 app surface.

archetypes.name: Continuous Monitor (Sentinel)
archetypes.fv: activity interpret · effect advisory · audience internal individual · authorisation autonomous
archetypes.def: Always-on standing watch: continuously senses and assesses signals and never acts autonomously — it emits advisories to a boundary channel for a human to decide. Autonomy is decomposed: autonomous sensing & assessment, zero autonomous action.
archetypes.ms: Foundry hosted agent (always-on) + Agent Framework; grounds via Foundry IQ real-time-pull (federated / MCP / web)
